sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Choose the correct interjection to express great joy: ___, our team has won the championship!
In the story 'Gilli Danda', what are the primary objects used to play the game?
options: A) A large bat and a leather ball
B) A long wooden stick and a small oval piece of wood
C) Glass marbles and a small stone
D) A net and a shuttlecock
questions.answer: B) A long wooden stick and a small oval piece of wood

questions.question_text: Which of the following sentences is written in the passive voice?
options: A) The gardener watered the plants.
B) She is singing a beautiful song.
C) The letter was written by Amit.
D) They will build a new house.
questions.answer: C) The letter was written by Amit.

questions.question_text: Identify the correct preposition: The brave dog jumped ___ the high fence to catch the ball.
According to the poem 'Vocation', what does the gardener spend his day doing?
options: A) Selling bangles in the street
B) Watching the gate at night
C) Digging the ground and getting his clothes dirty
D) Going to school with a satchel
questions.answer: C) Digging the ground and getting his clothes dirty

questions.question_text: Select the correct indirect speech for: He said, "I am very tired."
options: A) He said that he was very tired.
B) He said that I am very tired.
C) He says he is very tired.
D) He told that he tired.
questions.answer: A) He said that he was very tired.

questions.question_text: What is the correct synonym for the word 'courageous'?
Choose the appropriate conjunction: Neha was late for school ___ she missed the morning bus.
In the chapter 'Glass Bangles', what makes the bangles look so attractive in the market?
options: B) Their bright colors and the musical clinking sound they make
questions.answer: B) Their bright colors and the musical clinking sound they make

questions.question_text: Identify the adverb in the sentence: The old man walked slowly across the busy street.

sections.section_name: Section B - Short Answer and Grammar Competency

questions.question_text: In 'The Decision of the Panchayat', why did Jumman's old aunt decide to take her case to the village council? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Jumman's aunt went to the Panchayat because Jumman and his wife mistreated her and completely refused to give her the monthly allowance she needed for food.

questions.question_text: Rewrite the following sentence in indirect speech: The teacher said to the students, "The sun rises in the east." [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The correct indirect speech is: The teacher told the students that the sun rises in the east. The tense does not change because it is a universal truth.

questions.question_text: Why does the child in Tagore's poem 'Vocation' wish to become a watchman at night? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The child wishes to be a watchman so he can walk the dark, lonely streets freely with a lantern, chasing shadows without anyone telling him to go to bed.

questions.question_text: Change the following sentence from active voice to passive voice: "The clever fox tricked the foolish crow." [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The correct passive voice sentence is: The foolish crow was tricked by the clever fox. The object of the action becomes the subject of the new sentence.

questions.question_text: Fill in the blanks using the antonym of 'above' and a suitable conjunction: The treasure is buried _____ the ground, _____ no one has found it yet. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The correct sentence is: The treasure is buried below the ground, but no one has found it yet. The antonym of above is below.

questions.question_text: How does the traditional game described in 'Gilli Danda' bring children from different social backgrounds together? Explain the bond they share. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: Gilli Danda is an inexpensive, outdoor game played in the dust, which naturally erases social and financial differences among the boys. The players share a strong bond of true friendship, equality, and joy, focusing only on teamwork and the thrill of the match.

questions.question_text: Based on the chapter 'What a Tank', describe the immense size of the water tank and explain why it is deeply important to the villagers. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: The massive tank looks like a vast, sparkling lake stretching across the horizon. It is highly important because it stores precious rainwater for dry seasons, provides drinking water for cattle, and helps farmers irrigate their green fields to grow crops throughout the year.

sections.section_name: Section D - Expression and Applied Composition

questions.question_text: Write a short, formal letter to your class teacher apologizing for being absent yesterday because you had to attend a family wedding. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Respected Teacher, I am writing to sincerely apologize for being absent from school yesterday, the 9th of August. I had to travel out of the city to attend my cousin's wedding with my family. I assure you that I will complete all the missed classwork and homework by tomorrow. Yours obediently, [Student Name].

questions.question_text: Write a short paragraph describing the careful and highly artistic process of making colorful glass bangles as mentioned in your literature lessons. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Making glass bangles is a very delicate and artistic process. Skilled workers melt colored glass in incredibly hot furnaces until it becomes a glowing liquid. They then carefully stretch and shape the soft glass around iron rods into perfect circles. Finally, the cooled bangles are polished and decorated with golden paint.
